summary: Retrieves the complete JSON subtasks of a selected task.
parameter_summary: The explicitly selected task master identifier.
remarks: The server requires the Aufgabe (Anzeigen) profile. The manufacturer declares no fixed success schema; HTTP 404 can mean a missing task or missing authorization. The original signed Int64 selection is sent unchanged. Existing generated methods retain their null-data behavior. Fractional values use .NET decimal precision and may round or exceed its range; raw JSON remains exact.
